Write an rwl object as a TSAP import file

Source: R/extract_rwl.R
write_tsap.Rd

Writes an rwl object (as returned by extract_rwl()) as a tab-delimited text file for import into TSAP: the first column Year, followed by one column per series. Missing values are written as 0 and values are rounded to integers.

Ring widths in μm (e.g. mrw) can be written as they are. Scale parameters on smaller scales with scale_for_tsap() first; the function warns if non-zero values round to 0, and aborts on values beyond the integer range.

Usage

write_tsap(rwl, file, overwrite = TRUE)

Arguments

rwl

A dplR rwl object, e.g. as returned by extract_rwl() or scale_for_tsap().

file

Path of the output file (e.g. "mrw_tsap.txt").

overwrite

Logical, whether to overwrite an existing file.

Value

The written table invisibly: a tibble with an integer Year column and one integer column per series.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Ring widths in μm
rwl <- extract_rwl(df_rings = QWA_data$rings, param = "mrw")
write_tsap(rwl, "mrw_tsap.txt")

# Other parameters, auto-scaled
rwl <- extract_rwl(df_rings = QWA_data$rings, param = "cwtrad_mean",
                   prf_data = prf_sector, sector = 5)
write_tsap(scale_for_tsap(rwl), "cwtrad_mean_tsap.txt")
} # }
